evidence_blockers: The uploaded archive contains an auxiliary trace-mask U-Net, not the primary three-class PCB fault detector; the primary checkpoint and its provenance are still not provided.
The uploaded archive contains no training dataset, label manifest, training log or validation metrics for the auxiliary checkpoint.
No actual project training dataset or completed import audit is present in the repository.
No held-out test metrics have been generated from an identified primary detector checkpoint and audited dataset.
Checkpoint-to-ONNX prediction parity has not been tested for the primary detector.
Raspberry Pi runtime smoke-test evidence is not present in the repository.

The team reports that the physical build and tests are complete, but the pin map, cycle counts and supporting commissioning evidence have not been committed; commissioning therefore remains unverified in this repository.
Offline operation evidence is not present.
The original demo MP4 is present in the repository, but the official portal attachment/receipt remains unverified and the video content review has not been completed.

The team reports that the individual-contribution and AI-assistance declaration is available/submitted separately. The signed declaration/receipt and per-person mapping are not archived in this repository for independent review.
rule: The GitHub source/evidence checkout is considered reproducible only when primary-detector artefacts, dataset provenance, held-out evaluation, ONNX parity and Pi/offline evidence are retained. A separately submitted video or authorship declaration may satisfy the challenge portal requirements, but this repository cannot independently verify external submissions without their receipt or link.
